epics.title: Standalone Responsive Knowledge Base & Fast Search Tool
epics.jtbd: When an educational resident, researcher, or faculty member accesses the CRIE knowledge base on desktop or mobile, I want a fast, thoughtful, self-contained search and document exploration interface without third-party integration friction, so that I can immediately find and inspect clinical, academic, and normative resources in seconds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Visual regression delta < 0.1% against approved design mockup
epics.tocConstraintRef: Frontend layout alignment and mobile responsive styling
requirements: R1: Implement pixel-perfect layout and component styling aligned with approved design mockup 20261118052521-mockup
R2: Verify full responsive compliance, WCAG contrast ratios, and interactive states across viewports

slices.title: Implement pixel-perfect UI updates from approved design mockup 20261118052521-mockup
slices.jtbd: When implementing approved mockup changes for this epic, I want to update the existing frontend components and stylesheet against design/approved/20261118052521-mockup/mockup.html, so that the knowledge base interface matches the client-approved design specifications exactly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the approved mockup design/approved/20261118052521-mockup/mockup.html
When the frontend components and stylesheet in frontend/src and static web resources are updated
Then the resulting rendered UI matches typography, color palette, spacing, and component states of the approved mockup without breaking existing search and document navigation functionality
Given a mobile or desktop browser viewport
When viewing the updated knowledge base interface
Then layout flows responsively without horizontal overflow and satisfies WCAG 2.1 AAA contrast guidelines
slices.tocConstraintRef: UI presentation layer parity with approved mockup
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Mockup visual alignment >= 99.5% with zero broken interactive states
